name: THE PATRONS
note:
Men AND their furniture, as Tyler asked -- a vertical slice of the whole card table scene, cut at a column identical in every pose (x164-191 is 27 columns wide and unchanged throughout).
CUTTING WITH THE FURNITURE IS SIMPLER AND MORE CORRECT than separating it. A slice carries its own tabletop and chairs, so there is no separate furniture layer to align, no offset to derive, no chair backs left showing past a man, and no foreground mask to keep arms under the table -- the generator drew all of that correctly and it survives the cut. The left half of the table with its own slice of the tabletop and chairs: the far-left man turns and raises his cards, the dark-coated man lays a card down. Two beats.
